dedupe_keys.name: 84m 50k map provincial resource access map series

description: The Provincial Resource Access Map Series consists of 764 printed monochrome maps of Alberta at 1:50,000 scale. The source names roads, cutlines, facilities, pipelines, powerlines, railways, municipalities, hydrography and township-system features. Fifty reviewed packages are National Topographic System blocks, each bundling generally up to 16 map sheets in a 1:250,000 block. They are grouped as one source-defined map series. The source says the series is not updated regularly and sheets can have different publication dates. Native time-span fields say 2007, which does not establish a common survey date. The returned descriptors are descriptive pages; a uniform downloadable map-file format, coordinate reference system and numerical positional accuracy are not established. Geographic coverage is within Alberta. Related map components retain their native catalogue identities. The native packages list Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, but isopen is false. Actual file access and any cost are unverified. Distribution metadata mainly points to HTML/XML descriptive pages; these are not machine-readable infrastructure geometries. No map, PDF, image, archive or dataset body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are not stated.
